translations.text: From the elder to the chosen Cyria and her children, whom I love in truth—and not I alone, but also all who know the truth—
because of the truth that is established in us, so that it may also be with you, and you may be with us forever.
May grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Father's Son, be with you in truth and love.
I rejoiced greatly because I found some of your children walking in truth, according to the commandment we received from the Father.
And now I ask you, Cyria, not as though I were writing you a new commandment, but the one we had from the beginning: that we love one another.
And this is love: that we walk according to his commandments. And this is the commandment: that you walk according to it, as you heard from the beginning.
For many deceivers have gone out into the world. Whoever does not confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is a deceiver and the Antichrist.
Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what you have worked for, but that we may receive the full reward.
Anyone who transgresses and does not remain in the teaching of Christ does not know God. Whoever remains in the teaching receives both the Son and the Father.
If anyone comes to you and does not have this teaching, do not receive him into your house or greet him.
Whoever says to him, “Greetings,” will share in his evil deeds.
I had many things to write to you, but I did not wish to do so with paper and ink, because I hope to come to you myself and speak face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
The children of your chosen sister greet you. Grace be with you.
